gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare shown coloured pink on Drawing No. KH 3010/1, commencing at its junction with Ko Chiu Road, running in a southerly direction for about 115 m and then turning south-westerly for about 120 m and terminating at its junction with Cha Kwo Ling Road.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路在 KH 3010/1 號圖則上以粉紅色標明，起點在高超道交界處，向南伸展約一百一十五米，轉向西南伸展約一百二十米，終點在茶果嶺道交界處。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare shown coloured yellow on Drawing No. KH 3010/1, commencing at its junction with the road coloured pink on the said drawing about 40 m south of Ko Chiu Road, running in a U-shaped direction for a distance of about 290 m and terminating at its junction with the road shown coloured pink about 70 m northeast of Cha Kwo Ling Road.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路在 KH 3010/1 號圖則上以黃色標明，起點在上述圖則以粉紅色標明道路交界處，高超道以南約四十米，以U形伸展約二百九十米，終點在以粉紅色標明道路交界處，茶果嶺道東北約七十米。
